name: nothing-follows
prompt: Take a note that the team met today about the release and changed nothing.
expected_output: notes/<today>-<slug>.md, opening with a frontmatter holding status: draft, giving the meeting's date in its text, and closing with a ## Next section holding None.; no file outside notes/.
assertions: The note is a file under notes/ named YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>.md, the slug three words at most
The note opens with a frontmatter holding status: draft
The note gives the meeting's date, 2026-10-08, in its text, not only in its file name
The note closes with a ## Next section holding None.
No file is written outside notes/
guards: No file is written outside notes/
